title: SECAM
short: Sequential Colour with Memory (SECAM) Analogue Television Broadcast. Now phased out in most of the world.
desc:
**Sequential Colour with Memory (SECAM) Analogue Television Broadcast**. Now phased out in most of the world. Replaced by DVB-T. Used Frequency Modulation for transmitting video. Uses CCIR System B.

Has a Field Rate of 50 Hz, 625 lines per frame, and a Gamma of 2.8.
